Mornings sound different around here

Questions

Good questions, straight answers

What is Kingdomland Kids?

Kingdomland Kids is a Christian streaming app for kids. It brings together animated Bible stories like Marvelous Light, worship songs and memory verse tracks, life-skills shows, Black history music videos and family quiz games — all in one ad-free place made for families.

What ages is it for?

Most of our shows are made for kids 4–8. ABCs & Numbers is for toddlers and preschoolers (2–5), and Bible Adventures and Black History Beats stretch up to about 10. Parents tell us the whole family ends up watching.

Is it really free to try?

Yes. The Free plan needs no credit card. You get a 60-second preview of every video and the full app experience, so you can see if your kids love it before you pay a cent.

What devices can we watch on?

Kingdomland Kids runs in your web browser — phone, tablet, laptop or desktop — and on the big screen with casting or screen mirroring. One subscription covers the whole household.

Can I cancel anytime?

Yes. Monthly and Annual plans can be cancelled in one click from your account settings — no emails, no phone calls. You keep access until the end of the period you've paid for.

Do you offer church, school or group pricing?

We do. Churches, children's ministries and Christian schools can get partner rates and promo codes for their families. Visit our For Churches page or email hello@kingdomlandkids.com.
